map.零存整取和中途漏存怎么办？: What if a deposit is missed mid-term in a recurring deposit?
map.多数银行允许次月补存（限次数），超过则按活期计息或转为活期账户，会损失约定利息。: Most banks allow a catch-up deposit the next month (limited times); beyond that it accrues at the demand rate or converts to a demand account, forfeiting the agreed interest.
map.收益为什么比整存整取低？: Why is the return lower than a lump-sum deposit?
map.零存整取资金是逐月投入、平均占用时间短，整存整取一次性占用全年，故同等利率下零存: Recurring-deposit funds are put in month by month with a short average holding time, while a lump-sum deposit occupies the full year, so at the same rate the recurring deposit earns less interest.
